create_fsm_model: create a Django model that inherits from FsmHistoryStateModel to enable automatic FSM state transitions on save
extend_fsm_model: extend FsmHistoryStateModel by overriding _determine_fsm_transitions to define custom transition logic
provide_fsm_data: provide FSM transition data by overriding _get_fsm_transition_data to return a dictionary of context values
detect_changed_fields: detect changed model fields by calling _get_changed_fields to get a dict of old and new values
execute_fsm_transition: execute an FSM transition by calling _execute_fsm_transition with a transition name and change metadata
